name: uk.geomaster/atlas
title: GeoMaster Atlas
description: Sourced geology of oil and gas basins, fields and formations. Free, no sign-in, CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: search_atlas
tools.description: Search GeoMaster Atlas basins, oil and gas fields and rock formations by name, country, rock type, age, setting or role. Each result gives the entry id, a one-line summary and the page link.

query.description: What to look for, such as "Brent", "Permian Basin", "chalk reservoir" or "Jurassic Norway".

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: The full sourced Atlas entry for one oil or gas field or play: record, key facts, history, trap, reservoirs, source rock, seal, rock column, where wells do best, hazards and open questions, with numbered sources and evidence labels.

field.description: Field name or id, such as "Forties" or "johan-sverdrup".

tools.name: get_formation
tools.description: The full sourced Atlas entry for one rock unit (group, formation or member): age, lithology, setting, thickness, log response, reservoir, source and seal notes, members and the fields that produce from it.

formation.description: Formation name or id, such as "Brent Group" or "vaca-muerta-formation".

tools.name: get_basin
tools.description: The full sourced Atlas entry for one sedimentary basin: its geological history, rock column youngest first, tectonics, source rocks, reservoirs, seals, traps, migration and exploration history.

basin.description: Basin name or id, such as "Central North Sea" or "permian-basin".

tools.name: find_analogues
tools.description: Fields or formations that share sourced traits with one entry: trap style, main reservoir rock, depositional setting, age, fluid, other rocks and basin, with a similarity score and the source for every shared trait.

entry.description: Field or formation name or id.

kind.description: Whether the entry is a field or a formation, if the name is ambiguous.

tools.name: reservoir_quality
tools.description: Published porosity (%) and permeability (mD) values by formation, field or basin, each with its interval, how it was measured (core, log, petrography, model) and its source.

tools.name: petroleum_systems
tools.description: Source rocks and the fields they charged, with reservoirs, seals and timing of generation, filtered by basin, field, formation or words in the name.

query.description: Words in the system name, such as "Kimmeridgian".

tools.name: get_sources
tools.description: Full citations for the papers, memoirs, regulator datasets and lexicons behind the Atlas, by search or by the source ids that entries cite.

tools.name: cite_atlas
tools.description: How to credit and cite the GeoMaster Atlas: the CC BY 4.0 credit line, the DOI, a BibTeX entry and, if given, a citation for one Atlas page.

page_url.description: An Atlas page URL, such as https://geomaster.uk/atlas/fields/forties/.
